params.name: startTime
params.description:
Valid report Start Time in **ISO 8601 format**
Please refer the following link to know more about ISO 8601 format.[Rfc Date Format](https://xml2rfc.tools.ietf.org/public/rfc/html/rfc3339.html#anchor14)

**Example date format:**
  - yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ (e.g. 2018-01-01T00:00:00.000Z)

Please refer the following link to know more about ISO 8601 format.[Rfc Date Format](https://xml2rfc.tools.ietf.org/public/rfc/html/rfc3339.html#anchor14)

**Example date format:**
  - yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ (e.g. 2018-01-01T00:00:00.000Z)

params.name: rollUp
params.description: Conditional - RollUp for data for day/week/month. Required while getting breakdown data for a Merchant

params.name: breakdown
params.description: Conditional - Breakdown on account_rollup/all_merchant/selected_merchant. Required while getting breakdown data for a Merchant.

params.name: startDayOfWeek
params.description: Optional - Start day of week to breakdown data for weeks in a month

items.docs: Scope can be either account/merchant or reseller.
